A fringe of fine tactile filaments lies folded flat and close along the two parallel flanks, with the tips just reaching out at the edges. The flat bands taper to a tail end. Across all facings the giant ringed arm stays on the creature's own left and the small bud stays on the creature's own right: front view shows the arm on the viewer's right and the bud on the viewer's left, rear view shows the arm on the viewer's left and the bud on the viewer's right.

request.prompt: A single RimWorld creature sprite on a transparent background, painterly vanilla RimWorld style, realistic, clean dark outline. The vissler is a small, low, slippery, smooth-skinned, soft-bodied walker with a rounded head, two small eyes and four short legs. Its body is compact and small, with a body mass of steady volume, upright short legs, a level head and a consistent back height, neither lowered nor stretched. It has exactly one dominant arm: a big muscular arm about as long as the whole body and three times as thick as a leg, ending in a clear grippable hand, the obvious thing a hand would close on. The giant arm grows from the creature's own left shoulder, and where it meets the shoulder, a distinct pale seam or collar ring marks the clean break-line where it comes off. On the creature's own right shoulder, a small pale bud shows an arm regrowing in place of a full limb. The other limbs are plain short legs. The creature reads as a small body attached to one oversized, sheddable arm. Muted earthy body palette, with a warm orange accent on the break-line collar. Side placement is the same in every view: the large ringed arm belongs to the creature's own left shoulder and the small bud to its own right shoulder. Profile view with the creature's head toward the right of the image: its right side faces the viewer, so the near flank shows the small pale regrowth bud on the near shoulder and nothing else arm-related, while the giant ringed arm grows from the far left shoulder, partly hidden behind the body, with its upper arm and hand reaching forward past the head and the orange-accented collar ring visible where the arm emerges beyond the chest and head silhouette.
